core_obligations: The author constructs smooth metric collars with controlled curvature and strictly convex level sets, then glues them to a closed negatively curved exterior. Detailed Jacobi-field estimates prevent conjugate points and establish uniform hyperbolicity through repeated excursions into the original hyperbolic trapped region, producing the original codimension-zero isometric Anosov extension.

dedup.scope: Targeted DOI237 and Riemannian/isometric-Anosov-extension title checks found no same-source/object match in initial/public/worklist/current/third-line material. Actual near neighbors are own AHL267 thm:conformally-compact (complete conformally compact open Riemannian extension, general boundary topology) and thm:3D (oriented3-dimensional closed extension). Selected JEP237 gives a closed isometric codim0 extension in arbitrary dimension under strictly convex spherical boundary components. These overlap in some cases but have different dimensional/boundary/closedness scopes; original statement is not artificially restricted. thm_anosov_ext repeats this same theorem in the proof and is not counted separately.
